environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached to ALB with three rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet priority 1 with default action, (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet priority 2 with default action, (3) Custom rule group 'app-query-hygiene' priority 3 containing a single rule with ByteMatchStatement inspecting AllQueryArguments with TextTransformation URL_DECODE and LOWERCASE, using RegexPatternSet matching '(union|select|insert|update|delete|drop|alter|exec|xp_)\s' with BLOCK action. WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task role IAM policy has a condition restricting the task's outbound network to VPC endpoints only via aws:sourceVpc condition on all API calls, and the Fargate platform version is 1.4.0 with runtime seccomp profile set to runtime/default.
